primaryMetric.name: Win Rate
primaryMetric.definition: Unweighted mean of the per-question win rates of the odd-cycle nonlocal game on C_5, 10 question circuits at 150 shots each.
primaryMetric.uncertaintyDefinition: 95% confidence half-width (d = 0.05) over the 10 per-question win rates at 150 shots each, the Bernstein interval calculate_ci the results database recomputes

problemSpecific.description: Odd cycle nonlocal game on C_5, 10 question circuits at 150 shots each, run 1 of the Qupacabrathon 2026 hackathon.
problemSpecific.notes: Classical bound omega_c = 0.9. Quantum bound omega_q = 0.9755282581475768. One-sided exact binomial tail p = 4.655747e-20 against the 3 sigma threshold 1.349898e-03, so this run is certified at 3 sigma. Certified nonlocal content p_NL = 0.455951 (exact binomial lower bound at the same threshold; the CHSH ceiling is 0.41421). The counts are what the device returned: no readout correction, no extrapolation and no postselection was applied to them. Dry run 2 of the Qupacabrathon 2026 event pipeline; organizer-executed via qBraid Runtime 0.12.2, circuits exported from PennyLane as OpenQASM 2.
